Frequently asked questions

Are these tools really free?

Yes — every tool on utoline is free to use, with no account, signup or hidden paywall.

Is my data uploaded when I use a tool?

Most tools process your input entirely in your browser using JavaScript, so it is never uploaded to a server. Tools that work differently say so clearly on their page.

Do I need to install anything?

No. Every tool runs directly in your web browser on desktop or mobile.
